query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix due to its high hardness and wear resistance.
generation.intervention: Adhering AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy to the surface of the Cu matrix
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a solid solution phase
generation.mechanism: The high entropy alloy's solid solution phase formation, which is influenced by the δ value and ΔHmix value, leads to improved hardness and wear resistance.
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved wear resistance and surface protection of the Cu matrix
generation.baseline: Cu matrix without any surface treatment
generation.boundary: The δ value and ΔHmix value of the high-entropy alloy
generation.uncertainty: The exact mechanism of the solid solution phase formation and its effect on the wear resistance is not fully understood

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative wear resistant tests of AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy and Cu matrix under high-temperature and high-pressure conditions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear rate of the AlCrFeNiV high-entropy alloy is not significantly lower than that of the Cu matrix, the hypothesis is falsified.
